[[File:CrystalCloak-TheCrystalCloak.png|thumb|right|250px|The Crystal Cloak]]
The '''Crystal Cloak''' was a magical garment allowing the wearer to turn anything he or she touched into [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]]. The cloak once belonged to the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] of [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], but several years prior to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the cloak was stolen by the creature [[Gracca]] of the [[Floating Mountain]]. Gracca lived in his home on the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]], where he ruled for several years, turning anyone who refused to serve him&mdash;and often, accidentally, his pets&mdash;into crystal. It was believed that only a great warrior had the power to retrieve the cloak. In 3 ABY, the Ewoks [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] flew to the mountain on their [[Hang-glider/Legends|Ewok hang gliders]] and confronted Gracca. The cloak was destroyed when it fell into a pit of lava after Kneesaa used her [[Grappling hook/Legends|lasso]] to remove it from the Gracca.
